about.title: About Vienna Grand Tours
about.intro: A small, owner-guided tour business on the Ringstrasse — and a fleet of vintage-style electric vehicles that made it possible.
about.story1: I grew up a couple of tram stops from the Ring, and for years I watched visitors arrive, photograph the Opera and leave again without ever hearing why any of it stands where it does. I was working in a different industry at the time. The city kept nagging at me.
about.story2: When I finally started Vienna Grand Tours, I wanted the opposite of a coach: one small car, one group at a time, no microphone and no fixed script. I built a fleet of vintage-styled electric vehicles — forest green, white and burgundy — and spent a summer learning which corner of Heldenplatz catches the evening light and which lane behind the cathedral is quiet enough to tell a story in.
about.story3: That is still how it works. You book the whole car, we agree roughly where to go, and then we go slowly. I would rather show you four places properly than twelve through a window — and if the light is good in front of the Rathaus, we sit there a little longer.

about.vehicleTitle: Three vintage bodies, all electric underneath
about.vehicle1: They look like they belong to another century and they run on batteries. There is no engine noise to talk over, nothing to smell at a red light, and — in fair weather — no glass between you and the façades. Guests hear the trams, the fiakers and the guide, in that order.
about.vehicle2: The sides are open when the weather is kind and covered within a minute when it is not, so a shower changes the mood of a tour rather than cancelling it. Each car seats up to seven guests plus your guide, with room beside them for day bags and camera gear. We assign green, white or burgundy depending on availability — the experience is the same.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Everything worth knowing before you book. If your question isn’t here, write to us — a person answers.

items.q: Do tours run in the rain?
items.a: In light rain, yes — the weather covers go up in about a minute, and Vienna looks unusually good on wet cobblestones. In heavy rain, thunderstorms, ice or strong wind we do not drive. We will offer you another slot or refund you in full, and we always tell you as early as we can.

items.q: What happens if the weather turns during the tour?
items.a: We put the covers up and keep going; a shower is usually the most photogenic part of the day. If conditions become genuinely unsafe we end the tour early and refund the portion you did not ride, or move you to another date, whichever you prefer.

Cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before departure and you are refunded in full. Inside 24 hours we will usually move you to another slot if we can; if we cannot, the tour is charged. If we cancel — weather, technical trouble, illness — you always get a full refund or a new date, whichever you prefer.

items.q: Is the tour suitable for limited mobility?
items.a: There is one step up into the car, with a handrail on both sides, and we are glad to help you board. Once seated, the whole tour happens from your seat. A folding wheelchair, walker or cane travels with us; the car cannot take a fixed-frame wheelchair or an electric scooter, and there is no boarding ramp. Tell us about your mobility in the booking notes and we will choose stops that work.

Online at booking, on SumUp’s secure checkout. You are redirected to SumUp to pay by card, then return here for confirmation. Prices are per person and final (no VAT is charged under the Austrian small-business scheme): Bronze €25, Silver €39, Gold €49, Diamond €69. The total in your booking confirmation is the amount charged.

On the Ringstrasse near the State Opera, unless we agree otherwise — the exact pin, the departure time and a phone number arrive with your confirmation email. If your hotel is inside or just off the Ring, ask in the booking notes and we will usually collect you at the door.

items.q: How big can our group be — and why the three-guest minimum?
items.a: Three guests minimum. Each car seats up to seven; larger groups travel in multiple cars from our fleet. A booking is never sold by the seat — three seats is what it takes to make a private departure work. Couples and solo travellers are welcome: you book three seats and ride alone.

items.q: Can we change the route or the length?
items.a: Yes. The routes on this site are a starting point, not a timetable. Tell us before we set off — or halfway round — if you would like more time at the Hofburg, a detour past the Museumsquartier, or to skip something you have already seen. If you want to extend on the day, we will if the next booking allows it.

items.q: Which languages do you guide in?
items.a: English, German, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Chinese, Portuguese and Turkish. Choose your language when you book so we can prepare properly. Mixed groups are no problem — we switch between two languages without slowing the tour down.

items.q: Can children come along? Do you have child seats?
items.a: Children are very welcome and count towards the three-guest minimum. Austrian law requires a child seat or booster for children under 135 cm or 14 years, so tell us your children’s ages in the booking notes at least 24 hours ahead and the right seat will be in the car. Prams fold and travel with us.

There is room beside the seats for day bags, camera gear and a folded pram, but not for suitcases. If you are travelling on after the tour, leave your luggage at your hotel or in a station locker — the car is a sightseeing vehicle, not a transfer.

agb.intro: These terms govern every tour booked with us, whether through this website, by email or by telephone. Please read them before you book — the booking confirmation refers to this version.

sections.title: 1. Scope and contracting party
sections.body: These General Terms and Conditions apply to all tour bookings with Ahmed Wezza (‘we’, ‘us’), operating as Vienna Grand Tours. Differing conditions of the guest apply only if we have agreed to them in writing.

sections.title: 2. Our service
sections.body: We provide private guided sightseeing tours of Vienna in vintage-style electric vehicles from our fleet (forest green, white or burgundy): Bronze (30 minutes), Silver (60 minutes), Gold (90 minutes) and Diamond (120 minutes), with live narration in English, German, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Chinese, Portuguese or Turkish. Each car seats up to seven guests plus your guide; larger groups ride in multiple cars. Minimum three guests per booking. We assign cars from the fleet according to availability. Routes are indicative and may be adapted for traffic, road closures, events, weather or the guest’s wishes.

sections.title: 3. Booking and formation of contract
sections.body: A booking request through the website, by email or by telephone is an offer by the guest. The contract comes into effect when we send a booking confirmation by email. Please check the confirmation immediately and tell us at once if anything is wrong. Guests must be at least 18 years old to book; minors ride in the care of an accompanying adult.

sections.title: 4. Prices and payment
sections.body: Prices are per person, in euro, and are final. We operate as a small business under the Austrian Kleinunternehmerregelung and do not charge VAT: Bronze 30 minutes €25, Silver 1 hour €39, Gold 1.5 hours €49, Diamond 2 hours €69. The total is the per-person price multiplied by the number of guests, with a minimum of three. Payment is taken online at booking via SumUp’s secure checkout. Card details are collected by SumUp, not on this website. A booking is confirmed once payment succeeds.

sections.title: 5. Cancellation by the guest
sections.body: Cancellations made more than 24 hours before the agreed departure time are free of charge and refunded in full. Within 24 hours we will offer an alternative slot where we can; if none is possible, the full price may be retained. Cancellations must be made in writing to our email address or by telephone. Statutory rights of withdrawal for consumers remain unaffected where they apply; note that for leisure services tied to a specific date, § 18 (1) (10) FAGG excludes the 14-day right of withdrawal.

sections.title: 6. Late arrival and no-show
sections.body: Please arrive five minutes before the agreed departure time. We wait up to 15 minutes; a later start shortens the tour accordingly and does not reduce the price. If the group does not appear at all and has not cancelled, the full price is due.

sections.title: 7. Cancellation by us, weather and force majeure
sections.body: We drive in light rain. If weather conditions make the tour unsafe — storms, ice, strong wind, extreme heat — or if the vehicle, the guide or the roads make it impossible, we may cancel or shorten the tour. In that case you receive an alternative date or a refund of the price, or of the unridden portion, at your choice. Further claims are excluded unless we acted with intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: 8. Conduct during the tour
sections.body: Guests follow the guide’s safety instructions and remain seated while the vehicle is moving. Children under 135 cm or 14 years must travel in a suitable child seat when one is required — tell us when booking and we will confirm what we can provide. Smoking, open flames and standing during travel are not permitted. We may refuse or end a tour without refund if a guest is intoxicated, endangers others or repeatedly disregards instructions.

sections.title: 9. Luggage and personal belongings
sections.body: There is space beside the seats for day bags, cameras and a folded pram; we cannot carry suitcases. Guests are responsible for their own belongings during the tour. We are liable for lost or damaged items only in cases of intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: 10. Liability
sections.body: We are liable without limitation for personal injury and, otherwise, for intent and gross negligence. Liability for slight negligence is limited to the breach of essential contractual obligations and to damage typical of this type of contract and foreseeable at the time of contracting. This does not affect liability under the Austrian Product Liability Act or mandatory consumer protection provisions. The vehicle is insured as required by Austrian law.

sections.title: 11. Photographs and data
sections.body: We photograph tours occasionally for our website and social media, and publish images showing guests only with their express consent, which you may withdraw at any time. Personal data is processed as described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 12. Governing law and jurisdiction
sections.body: Austrian law applies, excluding its conflict-of-law rules and the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. For consumers, the mandatory protective provisions and places of jurisdiction of their country of residence remain unaffected. For merchants, the competent court in Vienna has jurisdiction. Should any provision be invalid, the remainder of these terms stays in force.

datenschutz.intro: We collect as little about you as a booking allows, we do not sell data, and we do not run advertising trackers. This page explains what happens to the information you give us, under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Austrian Data Protection Act (DSG).

sections.title: 1. Controller
sections.body: The controller for the processing described here is the company named in the Impressum, contactable at the email address given there. We have not appointed a data protection officer, as we are not required to.

sections.title: 2. Data we process when you book
sections.body: The booking form collects your name, email address, telephone number, the tour you selected, the date and departure time, the number of guests, your narration language, and anything you write in the notes field — please share health or mobility details only if you want us to plan around them. We need these data to perform the contract with you (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR); any special category data you volunteer in the notes is processed on the basis of your consent (Art. 9 (2) (a) GDPR).

sections.title: 3. Data we process when you contact us
sections.body: If you write to us by email, we process your address, your message and any details you include, in order to answer you (Art. 6 (1) (b) and (f) GDPR — our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries).

sections.title: 4. Data collected automatically
sections.body: Our hosting provider records standard server log data — IP address, date and time, requested page, referring page, browser and operating system — for the security and stability of the site (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). These logs are deleted after a short period and are not merged with other data.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We set one essential item in your browser’s local storage to remember your cookie choice; it contains no personal data and no tracking identifier. Analytics load only after you accept them in the banner (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR), and you can withdraw that consent at any time by clearing your browser storage for this site or writing to us. No advertising or profiling cookies are used.

sections.title: 6. Processors and recipients
sections.body: We use carefully selected service providers, each bound by a data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR where applicable: Netlify (website hosting and delivery), Supabase (booking database, hosted in the EU), SumUp (online card payments via hosted checkout), and our email provider for confirmation messages. Payment card details are entered only on SumUp’s systems, not on this website. Data is transferred to third countries only on the basis of EU standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision. Beyond that, we pass data to third parties only where we are legally obliged to — for instance to tax authorities.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep your data
sections.body: Booking and invoicing data are retained for seven years under Austrian tax and commercial law (§ 132 BAO, § 212 UGB). Enquiries that do not lead to a booking are deleted once the matter is closed, at the latest after twelve months. Server logs are deleted after a few days. Consent-based data is deleted when you withdraw consent.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to have processing restricted, to object to processing based on legitimate interests, and to receive your data in a portable format. Where processing rests on consent, you may withdraw it at any time with effect for the future. Write to the email address in the Impressum and we will respond within one month.

sections.title: 9. Right to complain
sections.body: If you believe we handle your data unlawfully, you may complain to the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Österreichische Datenschutzbehörde, Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Vienna, dsb.gv.at) or to the supervisory authority where you live.

sections.title: 10. Photographs
sections.body: We publish photographs showing recognisable guests only with express consent, given in writing or clearly on the day. Consent may be withdrawn at any time; write to us and we will remove the image from our website and social channels.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We update this policy whenever our tools or processes change. The version published here is the one that applies.
